newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia cosmonauts feel well-Mission Control expert.
newsitem.headline: Russia cosmonauts feel well-Mission Control expert.

text.p: Two Russian cosmonauts who returned to earth from the Mir space station on Thursday felt "normal" after landing, said a Mission Control expert in radio contact with the crew.
The expert, who spoke to Reuters, declined to be named. There was no official announcement on the cosmonauts' state of health.
The Soyuz capsule carrying Vasily Tsibliyev and Alexander Lazutkin back to earth had landed moments earlier on the steppes of the former Soviet republic of Kazakhstan.
The two cosmonauts had undergone a gruelling six months in space.
